purpose: Phase-6D tumour treatment schedule definitions. Distinguishes REPORTED biological timing (only where a primary source is extracted) from SCHEMATIC simulation timing. No actual dosing interval, mouse dose, or human-equivalent dose is invented; the frozen package's exact schedule is NOT extracted, so the default schedule is schematic.

single_schematic.description: A single schematic treatment event; treatment on from the start, no end.

treat_then_stop_schematic.description: Schematic treatment on, then discontinued to expose rebound-ready architecture.

untreated_control.description: No treatment event; untreated control trajectory.

timing_policy.no_fabricated_intervals: No biological dosing interval / dose / human-equivalent dose is invented.
timing_policy.reported_requires_extraction: A schedule is labelled reported_biological only if a primary source's schedule is extracted; otherwise it is schematic_simulation.
